info.title: Ticketmaster Universal API
info.description: Search Ticketmaster Discovery API v2 for events, attractions, venues, classifications, and suggestions.

get.description: Finds search suggestions in Ticketmaster by keyword and filters.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword to search on.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestion results to return. Ticketmaster allows 1 to 5 for this endpoint.

schema.description: Maximum number of suggestion results to return. Ticketmaster allows 1 to 5 for this endpoint.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
